slides.say: With a reducer, handlers stop saying what to do. They say what the user just did.
The object you pass to dispatch is an action. By convention, it has a string type describing what happened, plus any extra info.

slides.text: Keep actions minimal. Name the type after what happened: "added", "deleted".
slides.say: Put only the minimal information in it, and name the type after what happened, like added or deleted.
One user interaction should be one action, even if many fields change. Reset form beats five set field actions, and your action log stays readable.
